data.title: UMH PROPERTIES, INC. WILL HOST THIRD QUARTER 2026 FINANCIAL RESULTS WEBCAST AND CONFERENCE CALL
data.description: UMH Properties, Inc., a real estate investment trust focusing on manufactured home communities, will conduct a webcast and conference call to discuss its Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results. The event is scheduled for Tuesday, November 3, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time. Senior management will address the results, market conditions, and future prospects during the session. UMH Properties, Inc. is listed on NYSE under the ticker symbol UMH and on TASE as UMH.

data.title: Aphias Capital Announces Strategic Growth Investment in SNZweig
data.description: A private equity firm named Aphias Capital has revealed intentions to invest a majority in SNZweig Advisors LLC. This investment forms a part of the merging process of Stambaugh Ness and Zweig Group to establish SNZweig, a professional services and advisory firm targeted to support a wide range of companies. Aphias Capital focuses on aiding lower middle market companies and their management teams in flourishing. The merger is expected to create a stronger entity capable of providing specialized services to its clients.

data.title: Tufts Medicine Co-Leads $44 Million NIH Grant to Transform Advance Care Planning with Social Work–Driven, Video-Assisted Model
data.description: Tufts Medical Center in Boston has received a significant $44 million grant from the National Institutes of Health to pioneer a novel approach to advance care planning (ACP), aimed at initiating discussions about end-of-life care earlier in order to allow patients and caregivers ample time to articulate their medical care preferences. Trained social workers and nurses will spearhead these conversations, utilizing video decision-support tools accessible in 25 different languages. This research grant marks a major milestone in advancing personalized healthcare practices.

data.title: ENvue Medical Provides Nasdaq Listing Update
data.description: ENvue Medical, Inc., headquartered in Tyler, Texas, disclosed on September 15, 2026, that its appeal to the Nasdaq Hearings Panel for ongoing listing on The Nasdaq Capital Market was declined. Consequently, the Company's common stock (Nasdaq: FEED) will be halted from trading on Nasdaq and will instead commence trading on the OTC Markets starting September 16, 2026. ENvue specializes in medical technology catering to enteral feeding and therapeutic ultrasound. This shift will have significant implications for the trading and visibility of the Company's shares.

data.title: InventHelp Inventor Develops Improved Cleaning Brush for Shower Stalls (LGT-248)
data.description: A inventor from Louisville, Ky., with four children, created a new brush called the FRESH WADDA to simplify shower stall cleaning. Launched on September 15, 2026, the innovative brush offers efficient dirt and soap removal. The brush is designed for optimum cleaning, saving time for busy parents. The creation aims to streamline the cleaning process and improve effectiveness in maintaining cleanliness.

data.title: Updates to the Board of Directors of Ecopetrol S.A.
data.description: In a recent announcement dated September 14, 2026, Ecopetrol S.A. revealed that Mr. Hildebrando Vélez Galeano has expressed his desire to step down from his role as a member of the Board. Ecopetrol S.A. is identified as BVC: EC and NYSE: EC. This decision by Mr. Galeano marks a significant development within the company's leadership. The resignation is set to take place following the communication, impacting the board structure.

data.title: Ashley Williams and Nikki DeLoach Host Eighth Annual Dance Party to End ALZ Benefiting the Alzheimer's Association
data.description: A fundraiser with a pajama party theme, hosted by Hallmark stars Ashley Williams and Nikki DeLoach, and emceed by Jonathan Bennett and Melissa Peterman, gathered $300,000 for Alzheimer's research. The event, known as the Dance Party to End ALZ, took place in Los Angeles on Sunday, Sept. 13. This was the eighth annual occurrence of the fundraiser, which drew the support of various individuals and organizations.

data.title: Month-end portfolio data now available for Federated Hermes Premier Municipal Income Fund
data.description: On September 15, 2026, in Pittsburgh, Federated Hermes, Inc. (NYSE: FHI), a prominent active investing firm, disclosed the latest monthly data for the Federated Hermes Premier Municipal Income Fund (NYSE: FMN) as of August 31, 2026. This data includes information on the fund's composition and performance, offering investors a snapshot of its status and progress. The announcement highlights the continued transparency and accountability maintained by Federated Hermes, Inc. to provide stakeholders with up-to-date and comprehensive insights on the performance of the Federated Hermes Premier Municipal Income Fund.

data.title: RMX Industries Confirms QuantrusX Is Operating Daily Inside a Live Texas Facility
data.description: On September 15, 2026, RMX Industries, Inc. revealed that their product QuantrusX™ has been actively used since June at a high-level training center in Texas. RMX, trading under OTCQB as RMXI, is known for providing edge intelligence solutions. The technology has been serving its purpose effectively at the facility for several months, showcasing its value and functionality in a real-world setting.

data.title: U.S. Property Development Announces Grand Opening of Hamburg, New York Self-Storage Facility Managed by CubeSmart
data.description: A private real estate investment company, U.S. Property Development, centered on industrial, self-storage, and commercial real estate, unveiled the opening of its new self-storage facility in Hamburg, New York. The grand opening marks a significant milestone for the company's expansion efforts. Located in Hamburg, the facility offers storage solutions for individuals and businesses looking for secure and convenient storage options. This development signifies the company's commitment to diversifying its portfolio and meeting the growing demand for self-storage facilities in the area.

data.title: Scott Pelley and Solar Industry Veteran Jared Schoch to Take the Stage Together at RE+ 2026
data.description: A comprehensive dialogue is set to delve into the evolution of solar energy over the past two decades, the upcoming direction of the sector, and the leadership insights detailed in Schoch's latest book, "SOLAR COASTER: The Untold Story of the Solar Industry and One Man's Journey Leading with Soul." This discussion will take place in Las Vegas on September 15, 2026.

data.title: In HelloNation, HVAC Experts Rick Liberti And Jon McCartha Explain High Summer Energy Bill Causes And Solutions
data.description: In Chapin, South Carolina, a recent report uncovers that HVAC system malfunctions, lack of maintenance, and inefficient home practices can lead to a surge in cooling expenses during peak summer periods. Released on September 15, 2026, the research highlights the puzzling trend of escalating summer energy bills, despite consistent household routines. The study reveals that addressing these issues is crucial as households experience a spike in costs.
